bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 测试 30 日均线

read.en: Nvidia slipped 1.3% on Oct 12 to $226.32, its fourth straight loss and 7% below the Oct 6 record of $243.37. It is below the 5 and 10-day averages (both near $232.5) and sitting on the 30-day ($225.6), with the 100-day ($214) and 200-day ($202) rising below. MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 12, RSI is 49, and Parabolic SAR is still bullish at $222.
read.zh: 英伟达 10月12日下跌 1.3%，收于 $226.32，连跌四日，较 10月6日 $243.37 的纪录高点回落 7%。股价位于 5 日和 10 日均线（均约 $232.5）下方，正站在 30 日均线（$225.6）上，下方 100 日（$214）和 200 日均线（$202）向上。MACD 于 10月12日下穿信号线，RSI 为 49，抛物线 SAR 仍看多于 $222。

read.en: The $222–226 band (30-day average and SAR) is the near-term line; a close below it would point to $214–215, tested five times since April and close to the 100-day, then $207 (Aug 24 low). Resistance is $232.5 (5 and 10-day averages), then $234–237 (September highs, Oct 7 close) and the $243.4 record.
read.zh: $222–226 区间（30 日均线及 SAR）为短线关键；若收盘跌破，下看 4月以来五次测试且接近 100 日均线的 $214–215，其次 $207（8月24日低点）。阻力为 $232.5（5 日和 10 日均线），其次 $234–237（9月高点、10月7日收盘价）及 $243.4 纪录高点。

s.en: Tested five times since April; 100-day average
